d.a: Distribution (Fig. 49 j) Ozestheria typica comb. nov. is one of the most widely distributed Australian spinicaudatan species. It has been recorded in eastern Australia (especially in the northern Murray-Darling Basin in northern New South Wales and southern Queensland), central Australia (northern South Australia and southern Northern Territory, e. g., close to Alice Springs) as well as Western Australia (close to Paynes Find). It occurs predominately in turbid claypans, dugouts or swamps.
